citations.quote: Let's say calculator was not there. You you write two numbers and then add them on a paper and then finally make a number, right? So if you I don't feel you should be still enjoying that. If there is a calculator, use calculator. Getting my point Vinay.

patterns.observation: The speaker uses an analogy comparing traditional methods of calculation to the use of calculators, suggesting embracing new tools.

proposed_adaptation.action: Use analogies that relate old and new methods to clarify benefits of new technology adoption.
proposed_adaptation.limits: Do not assume analogies will be understood without contextual explanation.
proposed_adaptation.when: Explaining the transition to new technology in training settings

patterns.qualification: Based on a single source without independent corroboration.
patterns.situation: Speaker uses an analogy to explain the adoption of new AI tools.
